title: Open lattice faces are disjoint, and their union is flat near each of its points
statement: Assume (FG), the exact frozen Lean type of Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfr_face_geometry: for all P, k, the open unit cube has volume 1, and for index pairs p, q with strictly increasing first components the face maps are isometries, have diameter ≤ √P on the closed cube, and an open face point Φ_p(y) is at distance ≥ 1 or ≥ min(y_j, 1 − y_j) (some j) from any point Φ_q(y') of a different closed face. Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let S be a finite set of pairs p = (ι, b), with b ∈ ℤ^P and ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing for every p ∈ S. Write Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ Euclid k, Q₁ := (0,1)^k, F̆_p := Φ_p(Q₁), C := ⋃_{q∈S} F̆_q and V_p := span{e_{ι(j)} : j ∈ Fin k}. Then (a) F̆_p ∩ F̆_q = ∅ for distinct p, q ∈ S; and (b) for every p ∈ S and t ∈ Q₁ there is δ > 0 such that every z ∈ Euclid P with dist(z, Φ_p(t)) < δ satisfies z ∈ C ⟺ z − Φ_p(t) ∈ V_p.
